title: ClarkAtlanta vs Spelman: tuition, size, accreditation
summary: Clark Atlanta University (ClarkAtlanta) versus Spelman College (Spelman). Also searched as Spelman vs ClarkAtlanta. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University and Spelman College are both private nonprofit institutions located in Atlanta. Clark Atlanta University has an undergraduate enrollment of 3,603 students, slightly higher than Spelman College's 3,414 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Clark Atlanta University is $28,310, which is lower compared to Spelman College's in-state tuition of $31,556. These differences highlight variations in size and cost between the two institutions.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University and Spelman College have comparable tuition costs, with Clark Atlanta charging $28,310 for both in-state and out-of-state students, while Spelman College's tuition is $31,556 for both categories. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Clark Atlanta University is $27,000, slightly higher than Spelman College's median debt of $25,000. These figures illustrate the financial commitments associated with attending each institution.

When comparing ClarkAtlanta vs Spelman, the tuition rates are consistent regardless of residency status, and the median debt amounts for graduates are relatively close, reflecting similar financial outcomes for students completing their degrees at either university.
